name: Diagram domain model
ascii:
Project
|
+-- Corpus + shared source compactions
|
+-- DiagramSet / GenerationSession [many]
|   |
|   +-- CodeEntitiesSet [one; frozen after collection]
|   |   `-- CodeEntity [many]
|   |       `-- SourceRange + captured source text
|   |
|   +-- GenerationBatch [many]
|   |   +-- GenerationPromptConfig [one; immutable inputs]
|   |   +-- AgentRun [one per requested output]
|   |   |   `-- produces Diagram OR DiagramComponent
|   |   `-- DiagramCandidateBatch [successful diagram outputs]
|   |       `-- candidate references + rankings
|   |
|   +-- Diagram / DiagramComponent [many]
|   |   +-- ASCII content + origin + derivation links
|   |   `-- CodeEntityMap -> source evidence
|   |
|   `-- EditSession -> new edited artifact
|
`-- ProjectRepresentationCatalog
    +-- activeByKind -> preferred representation per view
    `-- ProjectRepresentation [many; stable identity]
        `-- Revision [many; currentRevisionId selects one]
            +-- ASCII or structured mapping canvas
            +-- evidence snapshots + mappings
            `-- optional provenance -> source session/artifact
